reviews.author: TroiMae
reviews.text: Terry Gilliam's controversies center on his vocal criticism of the #MeToo movement, calling it a "witch-hunt" and expressing fatigue with white men being blamed, leading to accusations of insensitivity and victim-blaming, especially after he claimed to identify as a "black lesbian in transition" as a response to the discourse, which sparked further backlash, including an actress's accusation of past misconduct and causing unrest at the Old Vic theater over a planned production.(08.12.2025)
